name: Jamming → lost-link
description: LOS and BLOS C2 jammed; UAV executes its lost-link procedure.
lossEvent: Airframe lost, or mission aborted before objective

name: GNSS spoofing → nav drift
description: Spoofer drags the navigation solution off the planned route.
lossEvent: Route deviation beyond tolerance, or airframe lost

name: False telemetry injection
description: Operators act on forged telemetry at the GCS.
lossEvent: Operator issues a harmful command based on false data

name: Flight software malware (supply chain)
description: Compromised signed update reaches the flight computer.
lossEvent: Malicious behavior executes in flight (crash, tamper, or exfil)

name: Stolen maintenance credential
description: Valid credential used for exfiltration or sabotage.
lossEvent: Mission or technical data exfiltrated, or configuration sabotaged

name: Ransomware on GCS / C2
description: Ground segment encrypted; C2 and mission records unavailable.
